propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks any large bug fix (>150 non-test lines) unless signed by a pinned environment, but no developer environment is pinnable without CODEOWNERS approval, making the gate unsatisfiable for contributors.

The gate rejects attestations from unpinned signing environments with 'mismatch' verdict (FLAG), even when a genuine plan review has been completed and the attestation is well-formed and lifecycle-valid.
The op-cert service has no client in the repository and does not persist signed attestations, so obtaining a prod-environment attestation is not an executable path for contributors.
The gate's rejection criteria gate on the SOURCE of certification (who signed) rather than on the FACT of a completed, attested plan review, creating a defect in its design constraint.

The attestation check must be redesigned to verify only the fact of a completed plan review and its lifecycle validity, while re-asserting subject binding (ticket id and kind from the signed payload) and removing the cross-host provenance verification chain.
